title: Task kinds declare their door and seat: the dock stops running server kinds
deviations_from_card: Per the critic revision: no TASK_KIND_NOT_STARTABLE, no api-response.ts or catalog edits - the nine server kinds answer the existing 403 TASK_KIND_SERVER_ONLY {kind}; SERVER_ONLY_KINDS set replaced by TASK_KIND_ADMISSION/dockMayStart; 9e834cf04's inner layers (assertConfinedToWorkdir, cleanupWorkdir guard) untouched. Order is IP bucket -> known kind -> door -> seat -> per-class buckets (critic's order, not the card's 'before any bucket'); case 2's throttling clause dropped. Case 5 (owner retry of an analyze row) proven hermetically as 'reaches the inputs check -> 409 TASK_REPLAY_INPUTS_GONE, not the dock 403' instead of actually starting an analyze run. tasks/seen gated on `read` (not allowlisted). Write set shrank (no api-response/messages); tasks-route-tenancy.test.ts anchors kept by leaving `if (!getTask(id, ws))` in DELETE (the seat reads the row kind with a second getTask).
notes: Red run: task-admission 6/6 red (module absent), coverage 1 red, gate 3 red + 2 guards green, route 8 server kinds + order case red with analyze a green guard; jd_build, repo_scan and companion_digest route cases were NOT executed red on the old code to avoid enqueuing real handlers (the source showed only analyze in SERVER_ONLY_KINDS) - counted red by source. Existing tests in python-runner-workdir-guard.test.ts (3), tasks/route.test.ts, tasks-route-tenancy.test.ts (8) and rate-limit-contract.test.ts (277) pass unchanged. tsc exit 2 ONLY on foreign paths: untracked kpi-sim/** and sibling in-flight tests (ats/ingest, analytics-stage-dwell, stageDwellGate, devcaseScoreHeadline, stageCadenceSavePlan, pipeline/command/reverse, ats import). Full test:unit exit 1 ONLY on foreign files: BROKEN pipeline-event-reasons, python-runner-concurrency (process-tree kill, env), apply-intake-scope, analyticsRenderMap, stageCadenceSavePlan, devcaseScoreHeadline; FLAKE analytics-stage-dwell - all siblings' in-flight areas, none imports task-admission. test:perf exit 1 on +4-5 KB over ceilings for 9 routes (hire-from-need, analyze, feedback-letters redraft, devcase approve/submit, intake promote, jds/generate, interview-kit, status letter) - none imports the tasks routes or task-admission.ts (my only new module, reachable only from app/api/tasks/**); these ride sibling uncommitted edits to shared modules (db/pipeline.ts, application-filing.ts, ...). No perf ceiling raised. Slot B (wave 3) should note: retry route now asks the seat right after getTask, before retryDecision; replayInputsMissing untouched.
